title: Single-Flight TTL Cache with Deterministic Concurrency Tests
instructions: Implement `SingleFlightCache` in `singleflight.py`: an async TTL cache where concurrent misses for the same key share one `asyncio.Task` load. Failures are shared with every waiter but never cached, and cancelling one waiter must not cancel the load (use `asyncio.shield`). Always remove the in-flight entry when the load ends.

evidence.label: Five concurrent misses trigger exactly one loader call
Serves fresh values from cache and reloads after the TTL
A value exactly one TTL old is treated as expired
A failed load raises for every waiter and is not cached
Cancelling one waiter does not cancel the load for the others
The load completes and is cached even if its only waiter was cancelled
Different keys load independently and are cached separately
